passages: *The Waterfall* was made by [Lipika Singh Darai](../../people/lipika-singh-darai.md) for LXL Ideas’ School Cinema. Shot around Khandadhar and the nearby forests of Sundergarh, it has English and Hindi versions.[^school-film]

She records location sound and designs sound for her own films, and edits for other filmmakers. Her editing credits include *The Sound Man Mangesh Desai* and *In the Shadow of Time*.[^darai-films] These collaborations sit alongside her directing, bringing another person’s material into the work of shaping a film.

Her filmography also describes an imagined conversation with her late grandaunt, developed while revisiting image and sound recordings from Mumbai in 2013. Her film letters include **କଙ୍କି ଓ ସାପ (Kankee O Saapo)**, **ରାତି ଓ ଭୟ (Raati O Bhaya)** and **ବି ଓ ଏସ (B O S)**.[^darai-films]
[^darai-films]: Lipika Singh Darai, [official filmography and film descriptions](https://www.lipikasinghdarai.com/films).

In a 2017 account, producer Syed Sultan Ahmed described choosing themes and selecting stories offered by independent filmmakers and scriptwriters. School Cinema describes screenings followed by discussion and workbook or digital activities, delivered by teachers with LXL training and support.[^school-cinema-model] For an Odia counterpart, makers and education partners could agree on a story, its language, payment and screening terms before production begins.

[^school-cinema-model]: Akhila Damodaran, [“City’s movie lessons win national honour,” The New Indian Express, 4 May 2017](https://www.newindianexpress.com/bengaluru/2017/May/03/citys-movie-lessons-win-national-honour-1600687.html); School Cinema, [programme description](https://schoolcinema.lxl.in/about-us).
